title: Towards Clinically Faithful Medical Image Captioning via Enhanced Vision-Language Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.19825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical image captioning is a technique that accelerates early-stage diagnostic workflows and enhances the interpretability of medical diagnostic AI systems. However, unlike general image captioning, clinically reliable captioning remains challenging due to grayscale-based modalities, subtle anatomical cues, specialized medical phrasing, and variations in data quality. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models, fluent outputs do not necessarily guarantee sufficient alignment with clinical concept spaces or evaluation criteria. To address this issue, we propose a framework that strengthens clinical alignment by separating and enhancing training-time alignment and inference-time alignment. We build a medical image captioning pipeline that integrates single/dual vision encoders based on BioMedCLIP and SigLIP2, a Q-Former, and a LLaMA-based decoder, and examine the contribution of auxiliary learning for UMLS concept/type pred

translated_title: 迈向临床可信的医学图像描述：通过增强视觉-语言对齐
translated_abstract: 医学图像描述是一种加速早期诊断流程并增强医学诊断AI系统可解释性的技术。然而，与通用图像描述不同，临床可靠的描述仍然具有挑战性，原因在于灰度模式、细微的解剖线索、专业的医学术语以及数据质量的差异。尽管近期大型视觉-语言模型取得了进展，流畅的输出并不一定能保证与临床概念空间或评估标准的充分对齐。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种框架，通过分离并增强训练时对齐和推理时对齐来强化临床对齐。我们构建了一个医学图像描述流水线，集成了基于BioMedCLIP和SigLIP2的单/双视觉编码器、一个Q-Former以及一个基于LLaMA的解码器，并考察了UMLS概念/类型预测的辅助学习的贡献。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过分离和增强训练时与推理时对齐的框架，结合多视觉编码器和辅助学习，以提升医学图像描述与临床概念空间的对齐性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that separates and enhances training-time and inference-time alignment, integrating multi-vision encoders and auxiliary learning to improve clinical alignment and reliability of medical image captioning.
